title: Spiced Steak Burrito Bowl
description: Fajita-seasoned steak over Mexican-style rice with roasted peppers, yogurt and fresh cilantro.
steps: Coat the steak in half the seasoning and sear 2 minutes per side for medium-rare, then rest.
Warm the rice and peppers with the rest of the seasoning.
Slice the steak, then divide the rice into bowls and top with steak, yogurt and parsley.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food steak burrito bowl

notes: Sliced steak cools faster in meal-prep containers, and the vitamin C in peppers helps iron absorption.
